goal: mergedPrReviewTarget trusts a real GitHub closing link the same way closingIssuesForPr already does, so a merged PR that closed its issue can record a post-merge review verdict without a PR-owned evidence pair
prohibited_actions: No migration, schema, grant, RLS, role or application data change
No credentials, production execution, review allocation, merge or promotion by worker
Never weaken the evidence-pair verification path when no real closing link exists
stop_conditions: Stop if the fix would weaken the no-link verification path
assumptions: A real GitHub closing link is authoritative evidence that a PR closes its issue, and closingIssuesForPr already trusts it without verification
mergedPrReviewTarget should be consistent with closingIssuesForPr and readReviewerOperationRoute for real closing links
When no real closing link exists, full verification (evidence pair, completion record, claims) must still run unchanged
